title: System requirements review
body: The requirements baseline the platform gives the supplier (SSS, IRD, SOW and their requirements), the tailoring and the package overview, agreed between the customer and the supplier.
rationale: ECSS-E-ST-40 5.2: the SRR agrees the requirements baseline.
reason: SRR held: successful. The requirements baseline is agreed (SSS, IRD, SOW); the tailoring's category C stands as a proposal for the customer to confirm (RID-SRR-001); RID-SRR-002 rejected.

title: The category is proposed, not confirmed
body: PAF/TAILORING.md proposes category C from kyr_host's use, but no analysis of the platform (ECSS-Q-ST-80 6.2.2) has confirmed it: the category of a supplier's software is the customer's, from the system that uses it.
rationale: Have the customer confirm the category, or state the classification as provisional until it does.
reason: Accepted: the tailoring states the category as a proposal (PAF/TAILORING.md <3>); the customer's representative takes it to KYR's next review; open item OI-01.

title: The capacity's bounds are the customer's, not the library's
body: SSS-003 bounds the capacity at 8 to 1024 (KYR_HOST_RING_CAPACITY); spsc_ring_init() accepts any power of two whose buffer fits in memory. Which bound does the supplier have to verify?
rationale: State whether 8 to 1024 is a requirement on the library or on kyr_host's configuration.
reason: Rejected: SSS-003 states the customer's need (the capacities kyr_host uses, every slot usable); the library's own range is SRS-001's, wider, and covers it. Both stand as written.

title: Preliminary design review
body: The technical specification (SRS, ICD) derived from the requirements baseline, the architecture (SDD: components and decisions) and the sources.
rationale: ECSS-E-ST-40 5.4: the PDR agrees the technical specification and the architecture.
reason: PDR held: successful with rework. The SRS, the ICD and the architecture are approved; three discrepancies of the README and the header against the code (RID-PDR-001 to -003) go to CR-001 to CR-003 for the next release; the code is right in each.

title: README says spsc_ring_is_empty(NULL) returns 0
body: README.md#L20 (API contract) says spsc_ring_is_empty(NULL) returns 0. The header says it returns 1 (app/spscring.h#L76-L81, 'matching MPSCring'), the code returns 1 (app/spscring.c#L263-L266) and the unit suite asserts 1 (tests/UTs/unit_tests.c#L293). SRS-013 and IF-005 follow the code.
rationale: Correct the README's API contract to 1.
reason: Accepted: the code, the header and the tests agree on 1; the README is wrong. CR-001.

title: README's wrap time of a 64-bit counter is off by a factor of 1000
body: README.md#L67 says a uint64_t counter wraps in about 584 years at 1,000,000 ops/s; 2^64 / 10^6 s is about 1.8e13 s, some 584,000 years (584 years is the figure at 10^9 ops/s). The 32-bit line (README.md#L66, 71 minutes) is right.
rationale: Correct the figure; SRS-011 states both rates.
reason: Accepted: the arithmetic is as the RID says; the conclusion (wrap irrelevant) stands, stronger. CR-002.

title: Which thread may call is_full and is_empty?
body: spsc_ring_is_full() reads the tail relaxed and the head with acquire: it is the producer's check; spsc_ring_is_empty() the consumer's (app/spscring.c#L263-L292). The header's Threading section (app/spscring.h#L18-L24) says only that size is a snapshot; called from the other side, the two answer a snapshot without the ordering push and pop rely on.
rationale: Say in the header which side each check belongs to, and that from anywhere else it is a snapshot.
reason: Accepted: no defect (atomic loads, no data race, push and pop call them on their own side), but the header must say it. CR-003.

title: Critical design review
body: The detailed design (SDD), the API reference from the code, the user manual, the validation specification and its cases, the first results of the release pipeline.
rationale: ECSS-E-ST-40 5.5 and 5.6: the CDR agrees the detailed design and the validation specification.
reason: CDR held: successful. The detailed design, the API reference, the SUM and the SVS are approved; every case has a recorded run at 0ad84dc1, every run passed; RID-CDR-001 and -002 rejected; RID-CDR-003 accepted (CR-004).

title: The unit suite is not run under ThreadSanitizer
body: VC-005 runs the integration suite and a reduced stress under TSan (utils/spscring_project.sh#L35), not the unit suite.
rationale: Add the unit suite to the TSan suites.
reason: Rejected: the unit suite runs on one thread; ThreadSanitizer reports races between threads, which only the integration suite and the stress create. Every concurrent path is in VC-005.

title: The smoke test hands one value over
body: tests/package/smoke.c#L1-L24 pushes and pops one value: the installed packages' behaviour is not exercised.
rationale: Run a suite against the installed packages.
reason: Rejected: VC-008 proves the delivery (the header and the library installed alone build and run a consumer); the behaviour is VC-001 to VC-006's, on the same code.

title: The header's @file names spsc_ring.h
body: app/spscring.h#L3 says '@file spsc_ring.h'; the file is spscring.h. Doxygen warns that the name is not an input file, and the reference generated from the header files its file-level text (constraints, correctness, threading, lock-free policy) under no file.
rationale: Name the file as it is.
reason: Accepted: a comment, no interface change; the API reference carries the header's file-level text from the source until it is fixed. CR-004.

title: Qualification review
body: The verification report of the release pipeline at 0ad84dc1 (1.0.8): every case's run, the coverage, the stress, the evidence; the requirements' verification status; the delivery.
rationale: ECSS-E-ST-40 5.6 and 5.8: the QR agrees that the software meets its technical specification.
reason: QR held: qualified with rework. Every case passed at 0ad84dc1; every requirement of the SRS is verified; CR-001 to CR-004 (documentation) stay open for the next release; the platform pins 1.0.7, code-identical (RID-QR-002).

title: The format stage did not run
body: The qualification run on the build host skipped the format stage: clang-format 18, the major the gate pins, is not installed there (ecss/DJF/runs/0ad84dc1/pipeline.log#L25-L26).
rationale: Run the format stage or say why the qualification holds without it.
reason: Accepted: the SVR records the skip; formatting changes no behaviour and every other stage ran; the format gate stays the CI's.

title: The platform pins 1.0.7, the qualified release is 1.0.8
body: kyr_host, kyr_server and the platform pin libspscring 1.0.7 (customers/kyr_host/deps.txt#L15-L16); the QR qualifies 1.0.8.
rationale: Qualify what the platform runs, or show that the two are the same code.
reason: Accepted: app/ and abi/ are identical between 1.0.7 (9e97782) and 1.0.8 (0ad84dc1), git diff empty; 1.0.8 only builds under kyr-build 3.1.1. The platform may move its pin at its next train.

title: The debs qualified are not the debs released
body: The run on the build host built development debs (Build-Root: none, ecss/DJF/runs/0ad84dc1/package.log#L1); their SHA-256 differ from the released debs'.
rationale: Record the released debs' SHA-256 beside the run's.
reason: Accepted: CI-DEBS records the released debs' SHA-256; the code they carry is the run's commit; the build root's reproducibility is the release's own record (0ad84dc1: built twice to one SHA256SUMS).

title: README: spsc_ring_is_empty(NULL) returns 1
body: Change the README's API contract line to say that spsc_ring_is_empty(NULL) returns 1 (nothing to pop), as the header, the code and the unit suite do.
reason: Accepted by the configuration control board for the next release.

title: README: the wrap time of a 64-bit counter
body: Change the README's example to about 584,000 years at 10^6 ops/s (584 years at 10^9).
reason: Accepted by the configuration control board for the next release.

title: spscring.h: the side each check belongs to
body: Add to the Threading section of app/spscring.h: spsc_ring_is_full() is the producer's check and spsc_ring_is_empty() the consumer's; from any other thread each answers a snapshot.
reason: Accepted by the configuration control board for the next release.

title: spscring.h: @file spscring.h
body: Change the header's @file line to spscring.h so that Doxygen files the file-level documentation under the header.
reason: Accepted by the configuration control board for the next release.
